shortDescription: Oil producers Chevron NYSE:CVX and ENI MIL:ENI and investors KEO Capital OMXSTO:KEOC and Primavera are among the companies set to sign energy agreements in Venezuela as soon as on Wednesday, two sources close to the preparations said.
